text:
The start-up failure is most likely a settling or margin issue, not a missing start-up path. At DC the simulated vref is 0.9216 V, right at the 0.9215 V floor. If the start-up transient settles even a few mV lower, the check fails. That diagnosis is an inference I haven't confirmed in simulation.

The edit makes three changes:
- **Centre vref:** raise the target so vref lands near 0.95 V, using the measured sim/model ratio of 1.013.
- **Stronger start-up:** shorten MS2 from L=20 to L=10 so the start-up injection is stronger.
- **Faster settling:** reduce the default Cx so node x charges faster.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Vref sits at 0.9216 V, at the lower spec edge; the start-up transient likely settles just below the window. Re-centre vref near 0.95 V using the measured sim/pred ratio, strengthen the start-up pull-up (MS2 L 20->10) and reduce default Cx for faster settling."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "R1":    (250e3, 120e3, 600e3),   # PTAT resistor
    "k3":    (11.5, 7.0, 16.0),       # R3/R1 ratio -> TC trim
    "vref_t":(0.95, 0.90, 1.0),       # target Vref (model calibrated to sim)
    "Lp":    (4.0, 1.0, 10.0),        # PMOS mirror L
    "gmid_p":(14.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "Ln":    (2.0, 0.5, 6.0),         # NMOS level-shift pair L
    "gmid_n":(22.0, 14.0, 26.0),
    "gmid3": (4.5, 3.0, 10.0),        # MN3 driver
    "Vrs":   (0.25, 0.1, 0.4),        # drop on MN3 source resistor
    "Cx":    (1e-12, 0.3e-12, 4e-12), # dominant-pole cap at x
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N = 8
    mQ1 = 4
    mQ2 = mQ1 * N
    R1 = p["R1"]
    R3 = p["k3"] * R1
    dVbe = UT * math.log(N)
    Ip = dVbe / R1
    Veb = 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 / (Ip / mQ1))
    Ic = Veb / R3
    I = Ip + Ic
    kcal = 0.9216 / 0.91              # measured sim/model ratio from previous iteration
    R4 = p["vref_t"] / (I * kcal)
    Rs = p["Vrs"] / I

    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.5)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.4, vsb=Veb)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], 4.0, I, vds=0.4, vsb=p["Vrs"])

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    n.dev("MP1", "x", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP2", "nb", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP3", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP4", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MN2", "nb", "nb", "eb", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("MN1", "x", "nb", "ea", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("MN3", "pg", "x", "s3", "vss", m3)
    n.R("RS", "s3", "vss", Rs)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "ea", m=mQ1)
    n.R("R1", "eb", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=mQ2)
    n.R("R3A", "ea", "vss", R3)
    n.R("R3B", "eb", "vss", R3)
    n.R("R4", "vref", "vss", R4)
    n.C("CX", "x", "vss", p["Cx"])
    # start-up: vref low -> sx high -> pull pg low (stronger pull-up on sx)
    n.M("MS2", "sx", "vref", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 10)
    n.M("MS3", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.84, 1.0)
    n.M("MS1", "pg", "sx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.84, 0.5)

    vref = I * R4 * kcal
    dVeb_dT = (Veb - 1.17 - 3 * UT) / 300.0
    dI_dT = dVeb_dT / R3 + (dVbe / 300.0) / R1
    slope = dI_dT * R4 * kcal
    curv = 0.03                       # empirical: sim TC ~7x linear model
    tc = (abs(slope) * 165 + curv) / vref / 165 * 1e6
    line_reg = vref * (mp.gds / I) * 1.2
    power = 1.8 * (4 * I + 40e-9)
    psrr = -db(line_reg) if line_reg > 0 else 60
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
```
